immutable_ground_truth.statement: Staffed hours matched planned hours for all listed dates from 2026-06-07 to 2026-06-15, with no drop during the backlog peak.
CHG-142 (billing-export invoice export batching flag enabled for us-east) was rolled back on 2026-06-14T00:10:00Z.
CHG-143 (support-console read-timeout increased from 5s to 15s for billing-status lookups) was retained.
CHG-141 (pricing-page copy update for annual-plan offer) was not rolled back.
CHG-142 is the only listed change immediately preceding the backlog spike and touches the system named in the highest-severity incident.

source_summary: Synthetic change and staffing notes for ops diagnosis pilot. Staffing hours matched plan (73-76 hours) with no drop during backlog peak. Three system changes listed: CHG-141 (pricing-page copy update, not rolled back), CHG-142 (billing-export invoice export batching flag, rolled back), CHG-143 (support-console read-timeout increase, retained). CHG-142 is the only change immediately preceding the backlog spike and touches the system named in the highest-severity incident.
